paper_id: Yang et al. - 2014 - Tagoram real-time tracking of mobile RFID tags to high precision using COTS devices
title: Tagoram: Real-Time Tracking of Mobile RFID Tags to High Precision Using COTS Devices
motivation: Airport baggage sorting loses >90% bags due to tracking errors; robot manipulation needs cm/mm precision
problem_framing: Given phase measurements from M antennas over N time slots, find tag trajectory f(t) at interrogation times
key_insight: Mobility creates virtual antenna array: treating tag as static while antennas move in opposite direction enables hologram construction
method_signature: Differential Augmented Hologram (DAH) using phase differences to cancel diversity term c
evaluation_criteria: Median error distance (mm for lab linear/circular tracks, cm for airport real deployments)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Main accuracy loss from versatile real environment; multipath still affects accuracy slightly (19-60mm)
evidence_for_taste: phase measurement as a Gaussian random variable
cannot ignore tag diversity in practice
uncalibrated θ violates our basic assumption
the majority of pixels have low PSNR values
main source affecting accuracy from versatile environment
thinking_moves: 把tag移动反转为天线等效移动，构建虚拟天线阵列
用phase差分消除硬件diversity term，灵感来自Doppler抵消
从Naive Hologram逐层递进到Augmented再到Differential Augmented
把求解定位问题frame为波叠加干涉的图像重建问题
用Gaussian概率建模热噪声误差，给signal分配非均匀振幅
